title: pcapng (next-generation pcap) signature
summary: A pcapng file begins with a Section Header Block: 0x0A0D0D0A (byte-order magic) followed by block length, byte-order magic (0x1A2B3C4D), major/minor version, and section length.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: pcapng supports multiple interfaces, comments, and custom blocks.
pcapng is the successor to classic pcap.
